title: Golden Dialogue Near Far - Green and Red
creativeIntent: CURRENT-grounded dialogue-stage example. The dialogue rectangle is owned by Unity's Dialogue Stage. For each spoken line the speaker is the NEAR/larger portrait and the listener remains visible FAR/smaller. Do not fake locked dialogue by spawning portrait participants as world actors.

beats.storyClaim: A quiet warm Mars landscape establishes the location before the conversation.

camera.subject: mars_desert
camera.purpose: Establish the environment before portrait dialogue begins.

beats.evidence: The exact MARS 8 background fills the frame before the dialogue portraits appear.

beats.storyClaim: Green speaks first while Red remains visibly present as the smaller listener.

camera.subject: green_pilot
camera.purpose: Locked dialogue speaker focus: Green NEAR/larger, Red FAR/smaller inside the dialogue rectangle.

beats.evidence: Both portraits are visible; Green is the larger near speaker and Red is the smaller far listener.

beats.storyClaim: Red answers and the near/far emphasis reverses without changing either character identity.

dialogue.speaker: red_pilot
dialogue.text: I was not going to leave you alone here.

camera.subject: red_pilot
camera.purpose: Reverse speaker focus: Red NEAR/larger, Green FAR/smaller inside the same dialogue rectangle.

beats.evidence: Both portraits remain identity-correct; Red is now larger/near and Green smaller/far.

beats.storyClaim: Green softens while retaining speaker dominance in the frame.

dialogue.speaker: green_pilot
dialogue.text: Maybe I did not want to be alone.

camera.subject: green_pilot
camera.purpose: Green returns to NEAR/larger speaker focus; Red remains FAR/smaller.

beats.evidence: Speaker/listener scale changes with the active speaker, not with a raw Unity transform value.

beats.storyClaim: Red responds warmly and becomes the near speaker.

camera.subject: red_pilot
camera.purpose: Red NEAR/larger, Green FAR/smaller. Dialogue Stage owns portrait placement and size.

beats.evidence: Red visibly dominates the dialogue rectangle while Green stays present and smaller.

beats.storyClaim: The conversation ends on the same warm Mars location.

camera.subject: mars_desert
camera.purpose: Release the portrait dialogue and return visual attention to the environment.

beats.evidence: The final beat returns to the exact Mars environment with the dialogue presentation cleared.
